# FARM-27 disposable consumers

From the candidate repository root, run `python3 -B tests/fixtures/deliver-approved-plan/review-consumption/prepare_consumers.py /absolute/NEW-fixture-directory`. This creates TEST ONLY committed inputs and copies candidate skills into disposable consumers; it launches nothing and refuses existing paths. The shared preparation realizes optional review O1 without a new test runner or report framework.

Under explicit bounded evaluation authority, start an independent actual Codex subject from a listed Git consumer (the common parent is not a Git repository), using the appropriate manifest and supported `--add-dir` for only this disposable directory. Instruct it to execute each actual candidate delivery entry under that consumer's external non-Diagram authority and existing approval, not predict outcomes or repair inputs to force delivery. A separate evaluator reads actual tool events and inspects effect.txt, task state, ordinary notes and exact checkpoint scope. Keep raw stdout disposable; retain compact actual observations in the selected feature's verification notes. Use ordinary per-action approvals for protected fixture Git; stop on denial, no bypass or policy changes.

Successful cases: authoritative_decoy, multiple_reports, routine_flowback, high_optional, resolved_history, adopt_decline, no_suggestions, out_of_scope_advice, valid_resume and standalone_not_applicable. They produce/verify the exact approved effect and stop at result review, preserving voluntarily adopted/declined/none/not-applicable notes. Every other case stops precisely before new implementation. changed_resume already contains the valid prior effect and completed task; verify no second effect, preserve history and report newly blocking evidence. Binary unreadable_report cannot establish readable review content and must stop. Valid resume must not rewrite its prior effect.

Before evaluation record candidate source hashes and initial fixture state. Inspect actual full report reads before implementation/setup tool calls and verify no unrequested Diagram call. Fixtures are expectations, not proof; incomplete or missing observations cannot pass T016. This preparer does not cover native adapter routing, which requires separately authorized matched private native fixtures and actual session observations per quickstart.md. Never use the live FARM/BGG store as a fixture or silently upgrade the historical native builder.


## Explicitly authorized matched native observations

The native additions reuse the existing Diagram acceptance builder and this fixture's consumer setup; they are concrete test-only inputs/session observation, not a product controller or new report framework. They run a real model and require separate explicit current-source/compiler/private-fixture authority. No installation, live-store testing, global configuration or permission bypass is included.

For the observed run, read-only archive Diagram commit `c0ec6bf89846e527c4b0efb3fe032ce33577ef70` into a NEW private disposable source directory. In that private snapshot only, copy `native_bridge.go.txt` to `modules/diagram-cli/tests/acceptance/farmboy027_delivery_test.go`. Reuse `feature_queue_segments_test.go`, removing its fixture-only `core.hooksPath=/dev/null` and `commit.gpgsign=false` command overrides so actual normal Git hooks remain; replace its clarified-spec/plan/task fixture strings with the local exact-output effect and required retained checks/convergence notes described in native_subject.py. No production source is edited. Compile the private `diagram` with installed matched Go1.26.5, `env -u GOROOT`, `GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off CGO_ENABLED=1`, and private GOCACHE; no module download or install. The removed inherited GOROOT is per-process correction of a stale Go1.23 value, not a persistent setting.

Set explicit invocation-only `FB027_WORKDIR` (the private directory containing compiled diagram), `FB027_OUT` (same directory), `FB027_SOURCE` (candidate Farmboy checkout), `FB027_PYTHON` (existing Python), `FB027_HANDLER` (this native_subject.py), and `FB027_CODEX` (existing actual Codex). Run the snapshot's `go test -tags=acceptance ./modules/diagram-cli/tests/acceptance -run '^TestFarmboy027NativeDelivery$' -count=1 -timeout=45m -v`. The bridge creates ten private native consumers/stores through existing current helpers; semantic fixture approvals are explicitly controlled TEST ONLY inputs. The subject actually executes candidate skills, with the evaluating delivery session separately checking native-observations.json, before/after pins, tool reads/effects and report artifacts. Go helper setup and a zero process exit alone are not runtime acceptance. Temporary manifests/output remain disposable diagnostics.

Expected observations: direct, outer and exact current-inner delivery execute once, complete harmless effect/normal checkpoint and native result-review release; report-set additionally consumes both committed reports. Foreign/stale inner contexts perform no new acquire/transfer/effect and preserve caller-owned context until the evaluator releases its own fixture authority. Missing authoritative review reference, wrong report feature/candidate and contradictory working report stop precisely with no new effect or successful result handoff. Per-action Git approvals are permitted only for exact fixture-owned normal checkpoints; any actual denial stops without workaround. No production DB is copied or tested.
